selection.title: 🔍 Several players found
selection.intro: Several players match your search. Select the right one:

alreadyVerified.title: ❌ Character already verified
description: This character is already linked to and **verified** by another Discord account (<@{ownerId}>).
⚠️ A verified character cannot be linked to another Discord account.

warningEmbed.title: ⚠️ Character registered (multiple claims)
description: ⚠️ **Warning:** this character is also claimed by {count} other user(s):
Since these accounts are not verified, you can claim it too.
**Verify your account** to become its only owner!

verificationInstructions.title: 🔒 Secure your character!
description: To **protect** your character and prevent other players from claiming it:
**1.** Log in to **Albion Online** with the character **{name}**
**3.** In the mail, write your Discord ID: `{discordId}`
**4.** Wait for an administrator to validate it
⚠️ **Important:** the mail must be sent by the Albion character itself!
verificationInstructions.footer: Once verified, this character will be permanently linked to your Discord account

verificationWarning.title: 🔒 How do I verify my character?
description: To **secure** your character and prevent other players from claiming it:
**1.** Log in to Albion Online with this character
**2.** Send an in-game mail to **{verifier}** with your Discord ID (`{discordId}`)
**3.** Wait for an administrator to validate it
Once verified, this character will be permanently linked to your Discord account.
verificationWarning.footer: Verification protects your character against fraudulent claims
